# Commands

Every command HelioFITS Studio has, as the menus, Help > Search Controls and the tours know it. Settings > Keybindings shows and changes the keyboard shortcut of each one. The id is the command's stable name in the command registry (docs/commands.md). A command marked *discards work* can throw away unsaved work or data.

## File

```{list-table}
:header-rows: 1
:widths: 40 40 20

* - Command
  - What it does
  - Id
* - File > Start New Session
  - *(discards work)*
  - `newSession`
* - File > Open Session...
  - *(discards work)*
  - `openSession`
* - File > Open Recent > Clear Menu
  - Forget the recent sessions list
  - `clearRecents`
* - File > Close Window
  - *(discards work)*
  - `closeWindow`
* - File > Save Session
  -
  - `saveSession`
* - File > Save Session As...
  -
  - `saveSessionAs`
* - File > Export Session with Data...
  - Save the session plus a .data.zip of its local files, to open on another computer
  - `exportSessionWithData`
* - File > Revert to Saved
  - *(discards work)*
  - `revertToSaved`
* - File > Set Current Session as Default
  -
  - `setDefaultSession`
* - File > Clear Default Session
  -
  - `clearDefaultSession`
* - File > Reload Datasets Listings
  -
  - `reloadSources`
* - File > Open New Window
  -
  - `newWindow`
* - File > Quit
  - *(discards work)*
  - `quit`
* - File > Copy Provenance
  -
  - `copyProvenance`
* - File > Quick Share
  - Record one loop as a movie that plays anywhere, then show it in the file manager; your recording settings are not changed
  - `quickShare`
* - File > Share Scene...
  - Save the scene for someone else: home folder written as ~, local files outside the cache listed first
  - `shareScene`
* - File > Show Dataset Folders
  - Browse the cache as one folder per dataset (links, or a files.txt listing on Windows); the cache is not changed
  - `datasetFolders`
* - File > Open Exports Folder
  - Show the folder movies, screenshots and metadata are exported to
  - `openExportsFolder`
* - File > Open Export Record...
  - Read an export's processing record (.hfrec) as a report; copy it as a methods paragraph or LaTeX, or save a Python script
  - `openExportRecord`
* - File > Upgrade Sidecars in Folder...
  - Rename the older .hfrec.json export records in a folder and its subfolders to .hfrec and add a preview to those without one, after a count to confirm; never replaces a .hfrec
  - `migrateSidecars`
* - File > New from Template...
  - Start from a template: a saved scene whose dates can follow the newest data
  - `newFromTemplate`
* - File > Save as Template...
  - Save this scene as a template: a starting point with a name, a description, a thumbnail and a time rule
  - `saveAsTemplate`
```

## Managers

```{list-table}
:header-rows: 1
:widths: 40 40 20

* - Command
  - What it does
  - Id
* - Managers > Study Manager...
  - What a scene exports: a table of views to export as a set (projection, lambda, field of view, layers), and study templates to start one from
  - `study`
* - Managers > Task Manager...
  - What is downloading, loading or computing, and the export queue (also: click the footer's spinner)
  - `taskManager`
* - Managers > Template Manager...
  - Manage scene templates: open, duplicate, rename, edit, share, set as startup or retire
  - `templates`
* - Managers > Toolbar Manager...
  - Choose which tools are on the toolbar and in what order (unlocks the panels first when they are locked)
  - `toolbarManager`
* - Managers > Cache Manager...
  - What is on disk, in Studio's cache and the FITS library: load, reveal, import, verify or delete
  - `cacheManager`
* - Managers > 3D Model Manager...
  - Spacecraft models to download, preview and add to the scene at their real positions
  - `modelManager`
* - Managers > Theme Manager...
  - Pick, customize and save interface themes (View > Theme is the quick picker)
  - `themeManager`
* - Managers > Keybindings Manager...
  - Every command with its keybinding: search, change or reset (opens Settings on the Keybindings tab)
  - `keybindingsManager`
```

## Commands that take arguments

These are run by scripts and Search Controls rather than from a menu; the arguments are named after the description.

```{list-table}
:header-rows: 1
:widths: 40 40 20

* - Command
  - What it does
  - Id
* - Identify Under Cursor
  - No arguments
  - `identifyUnderCursor`
* - Identify Tooltip
  - No arguments
  - `identifyTooltip`
* - Identify Stars
  - No arguments
  - `identifyStars`
* - Find Body...
  - No arguments
  - `identifyFindBody`
* - A live record of what Studio does: commands from scripts and assistants, downloads, disk, Core's output, memory and the log (also: click the footer's lights)
  - No arguments
  - `activityWindow`
* - Show the movie frame with this number (0 is the first)
  - Arguments: `frame`
  - `seekFrame`
* - Move the movie to the frame nearest this time
  - Arguments: `time`
  - `seekTime`
* - Rotate the view 90 degrees about one axis of the screen
  - Arguments: `axis`
  - `rotateView90`
* - Add an image layer for a dataset over a time range and wait for its frames
  - Arguments: `observatory`, `wait`, `start`, `end`, `source`, `cadence_s`, `dataset`
  - `layerAdd`
* - The image layers in the scene, with their ids
  - No arguments
  - `layerList`
* - Remove an image layer from the scene
  - Arguments: `layer_id`
  - `layerRemove`
* - Read a layer's frames again; a FITS library layer queries the cache afresh, so files added since are picked up
  - Arguments: `wait`, `layer_id`
  - `layerReload`
* - Set a layer's image filter (optionally chained with more filters, each with a strength) and its FITS display parameters
  - Arguments: `filter`, `chain`, `layer_id`, `params`
  - `filterSet`
* - Set the view: projection, zoom, Box-Cox lambda, tracking, corona
  - Arguments: `multiview`, `show_corona`, `zoom`, `differential_rotation`, `projection`, `warp_lambda`, `tracking`
  - `viewSet`
* - The current view
  - No arguments
  - `viewGet`
* - Write one FITS frame's decoded values, as the layer shows them before any colour table, to an hf-decode-dump/1 document and return its path
  - Arguments: `layer_id`, `frame`
  - `frameGet`
* - Render the scene as an export would, to a PNG in Studio's cache (not among the exports), and return its path
  - Arguments: `long_side`
  - `previewRender`
* - Load a scene from a session file (.jhv), a session data archive (.data.zip) or an export's processing record (.hfrec); a record opens in a new window by default and checks its picture against the record's, one frame of a movie unless range
  - Arguments: `path`, `range`, `window`
  - `sessionLoad`
* - Export the frame on screen as a PNG, with its processing record beside it
  - Arguments: `path`, `long_side`, `bundle_data`
  - `exportStill`
* - Export one loop of the loaded frames as a movie in the format the settings choose, with its processing record beside it
  - Arguments: `path`, `long_side`, `bundle_data`
  - `exportMovie`
* - Name the Sun, Moon and planets at a helioprojective direction, as an observer sees them
  - Arguments: `observer`, `tx_deg`, `ty_deg`, `tolerance_deg`, `time`
  - `identifyAt`
* - Where a body is in an observer's sky: helioprojective Tx and Ty, distance, elongation, and whether the active layer's field holds it
  - Arguments: `observer`, `time`, `body`
  - `identifyLocate`
* - When each body is in a field of view over a time range, by body and by UTC day: find dates with or without the Moon
  - Arguments: `observer`, `inner_deg`, `half_width_deg`, `field`, `outer_deg`, `start`, `end`, `step_minutes`
  - `identifyInField`
* - Turn the cursor identifier and its tooltip and stars on or off, and set its tolerances; answers with every setting
  - Arguments: `earth_observer_uncertainty_km`, `light_time`, `tooltip`, `star_max_magnitude`, `pluto`, `stars`, `enabled`, `star_names_bayer`, `tolerance_pixels`, `tooltip_dwell_ms`, `pulse`, `star_names_iau`, `glow`
  - `identifySet`
* - Pin a body's label to the view, or unpin it, or list the pins; pins follow their body and are saved with the session
  - Arguments: `pinned`, `clear`, `body`
  - `identifyPin`
* - Read Studio's activity record: commands from scripts and assistants with their answers and timings, downloads, disk, HelioFITS Core's output, memory changes and log lines, oldest first, after since_seq
  - Arguments: `since_seq`, `limit`, `kinds`
  - `activityLog`
* - Open the Activity window, on one kind of line if light is given, so the person can watch what Studio does
  - Arguments: `light`
  - `activityShow`
* - List every command: its id, what it does and what it changes
  - No arguments
  - `listCommands`
* - Say what a command or control is, where it is, its shortcut, and which tours and tips show it
  - Arguments: `id`
  - `describeControl`
```
